notes.title: Five years after launch, Lightning Returns: Final Fantasy 13 gets a surprise patch on PC
notes.content:
Surprise! Lighting Returns: Final Fantasy 13 just got a surprise patch five years after the game came out on PC.

Square Enix's role-playing adventure, which launched on PC in December 2015, received an update to fix an issue with Lightning's voice not being played in some scenes, according to a note on Steam.

How random! Or is it? As many fans have already speculated, this update may be more about tidying up the game ahead of a launch into Xbox Game Pass.

Read more

notes.title: 12/7/2021 Update
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of LIGHTNING RETURNS: FINAL FANTASY XIII.
An update of the game has been implemented as of 12th July 2021.

Update Content:
Fixed an issue of Lightning’s voice not being played in some scenes.

We hope you continue to have fun with LIGHTNING RETURNS: FINAL FANTASY XIII.

notes.title: Feb 2016 Update
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of LIGHTNING RETURNS: FINAL FANTASY XIII. 
An update the game has been implemented as of Feb 24rd 2016

Update content:
1. Alongside Valve’s SDK updates, the game can now be played even when Steam Cloud is turned off.
2. Display issues when using several models of graphics card such as the ATI Radeon HD 4800 Series have now been improved.

We hope you continue to have fun with LIGHTNING RETURNS: FINAL FANTASY XIII. 
Thanks

notes.title: 24th December 2015 Game Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone and thank you for playing LIGHTNING RETURNS FINAL FANTASYXIII!

On the 24th of December 2015 we issued a game update, the details of which are below: 

Changes to game content:

1. The following display resolution settings have been added:
「3840 x 2160」「3200 x 1800」「2880 x 1620」「2560 x 1440」
「2400 x 1350」「2160 x 1215」

Caution: Please note that if a resolution setting is selected that is not supported by your display, the game will automatically run at the maximum resolution available within your PC environment.

Caution: Depending on the resolution settings selected, the game may suffer considerable drops in processing speed or cease to boot properly. It is recommended that you play using resolution settings suitable for your PC’s specifications.

2. Support for booting the game in an offline environment:
As LIGHTNING RETURNS FINAL FANTASY XIII is a software title that supports SteamCloud, it previously required an online environment for play. We have listened to your feedback, however, and added in the ability to boot the game in an offline environment as well.

We hope you continue to enjoy LIGHTNING RETURNS FINAL FANTASY XIII and wish you a very happy holiday.
